system.description:
You perform a modified version of the Mind body transfer technique on a humanoid creature you can see within range disassociating the mind and bodies activities and then forcing them to reset causing a significant amount of Psychic damage to the creature. Target creature must make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: No further effects.

Success: Targets take 2d8 psychic damage.

Failure: Target take 4d8 psychic damage and they gain 1 Mental Overwrite.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they take 5d8 psychic damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d8. Beginning at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Mental Overwrite inflicted by +1. Beginning at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Mental Overwrite inflicted by +1.
